thread:
oliver: FYI I noticed the API ref response schema for POST /v1/generate is inconsistent. The schema lists a top-level "metadata" object and `outputs` array, but the example response still uses `choices` and omits `metadata`. That confuses integrators and the SDK mappers.

nina: ah ok. Which should be canonical?

oliver: runtime returns { "outputs": [ ... ], "metadata": { "model": "redwood-v1" } } now. `choices` is legacy. We should update the example response to match `outputs` (and update streaming docs to show events with "delta" under outputs).

rachel: also the Python snippet does `resp.json()["choices"][0]` which will break. I'll open a tiny PR to update snippets to use `resp.json()["outputs"][0]` and add a compatibility note showing how to map legacy `choices` to `outputs`.

oliver: please also add a short migration note under the generate page: two bullets: 1) responses now use `outputs` + `metadata`; 2) streaming events emit partial `outputs` deltas instead of `choices`. Mention that server still emits `choices` temporarily for older clients but will be removed after one release cycle.

nina: for the response schema block, add an explicit example JSON block and run `./scripts/snippet-lint` since CI missed missing metadata before. I'll also grep for `choices` in `docs/snippets` to update tests.

rachel: PR will replace all `choices` occurrences in examples, update the JS and Go mappers, and add a unit test `tests/fixtures/generate-response-outputs.json`. Tagging @oliver for review.

docs-bot: Draft PR opened by rachel: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1021 (WIP)

oliver: thanks. If all green, merge after one reviewer sign-off. Small change but touches many snippets so linting is required.

nina: reviewing now. Small nit: keep legacy mapping snippet in a collapsed admon (not inline) so example stays simple.

rachel: will do.
